SELECT id, tenant_id AS tenantId, tool_id AS toolId, policy_type AS policyType, policy_value AS policyValue, status
FROM ya_tenant_tool_policy
WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( tool_id = #{toolId} OR tool_id IS NULL )
ORDER BY CASE WHEN tool_id = #{toolId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
